name: Iwasaki Jouji
source:
Birthplace: Tokyo
Lives alone.
A guy with Italian blood who has a foreign looking face.
Because his parents weren't there often he was raised by his young newly married aunt.
He's good at showing his feelings and always acts proactive when it comes to girls he likes. He hates being alone.
